name: simple-writing
description: Write plain text that a reader understands on one read, in the language of the user. It is a multilingual version of SimpleEnglish by AminBlg. It keeps the discipline of ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: short sentences, one word one meaning, active voice, condition before command, terms defined at first use.

interface.shortDescription: Write clear technical text in your language with ASD-STE100 rules.
interface.longDescription: Load Simplified Technical English rules automatically for documentation, procedures, error messages, runbooks, release notes, and incident reports. The model writes in the language of the user.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this technical text in Simple English.
Write this procedure with ASD-STE100 rules.
Check this document for Simple English violations.
